D23 (MC023): the schema cannot re-label a sourced lifetime row as species 'component' from the records (parameter-remap.csv changes only the parameter), so the campaign-life rows are ruled out instead; a records-level target remap would let them be kept as component. What remains: furnace_regenerative and furnace_electric 25 years (Gielen 1997 plant life), furnace_oxy-fuel 15 years (DOE 2023); furnace_hybrid-electric has no asset-life row and takes the sibling estimate (check it lands in 15-25). REBUILD COST: only Scalet 2013 prints one, for float glass (p.16: a major rebuild EUR 30-50 million every 12-15 years; a new 500 t/d float line EUR 100-150 million). As a fixed O&M allowance that is 40 MEUR / 13.5 years / 182,500 t/yr = about 16 EUR per t-per-yr (11-23), 2013 EUR. Adding it to furnace_regenerative opex-fixed needs a new derived row in the Scalet extraction (data/raw-data/gov-eu/jrc/scalet_2013_glass-bref_jrc.csv, opex-fixed, target component or a note 'rebuild allowance'); no source gives a rebuild cost for the electric, oxy-fuel or hybrid furnaces, so none is added there.
